title: build(deps-dev): bump @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin from 8.71.2 to 8.72.0
intent: Dev-tooling currency, no advisory. The title names one package but this moves the WHOLE @typescript-eslint family in lockstep: eslint-plugin 8.72.0 declares peerDependencies @typescript-eslint/parser ^8.72.0 and pins its internals (scope-manager, type-utils, utils, visitor-keys) to exactly 8.72.0, so npm moves parser and every internal with it. 8.72.0: lazy-loaded rules; await-thenable allowMixedPromiseArrays option; typescript-estree errors on `abstract export`; no-deprecated now reports deprecated properties in object literals; require-array-sort-compare checks tuples; several TS<5 crash fixes. GitHub's advisory API returns 0 for eslint-plugin and parser at 8.72.0.
behavior_change: None in shipped output and none in lint results, verified by running both rather than assumed. TEN packages moved, not one. Lockfile vs merge base 02032884: 400 entries before and after, ZERO added, ZERO removed, exactly ten node_modules entries version-changed, all 8.71.2 -> 8.72.0: @typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin, parser, project-service, scope-manager, tsconfig-utils, type-utils, types, typescript-estree, utils, visitor-keys. Root differs only in devDependencies['@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin'] ^8.71.2 -> ^8.72.0; the declared parser range stays ^8.71.2 (satisfied by 8.72.0). The whole family is consistent at one version, which is what typescript-eslint requires. A/B vite build: 199 vs 199 files, byte-identical (dev-only tooling, as expected). A/B eslint (`eslint . --ext .ts,.vue --format json`, the lint:report script CI uses) on origin/main vs this branch: 7013 vs 7013 messages, the per-(rule,severity) counts are identical and the (file,line,rule,message) sets are identical -- zero added, zero removed. scripts/ci/check_client_lint_ratchet.py on this branch's report: PASS.

diff_articulation.what_changed: packages/client/package.json moves devDependencies['@typescript-eslint/eslint-plugin'] from ^8.71.2 to ^8.72.0. package-lock.json moves the ten @typescript-eslint/* entries 8.71.2 -> 8.72.0 and updates the root range. Dependabot's incidental peer-flag churn on 16 unchanged-version entries was reverted so nothing else moves.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: Dependabot currency; this manifest exists because Dependabot cannot author one (CBSP21-NOBORROW-001). No existing manifest covers this diff, and borrowing one is what the rule refuses -- PR #296's silent zod 4 -> 3 revert is why.

Integrity of every moved entry == `npm view <pkg>@<ver> dist.integrity`; published via GitHub Actions OIDC with SLSA provenance; no preinstall/install/postinstall scripts.

py -3.11 scripts/ci/check_cbsp21_gate.py --changed-files <PR files> and scripts/ci/check_cbsp21_patch_input.py run locally before push.

A/B eslint JSON report origin/main vs this branch: 7013 vs 7013, identical message sets. check_client_lint_ratchet.py: PASS (it also reports the baseline in scripts/ci/client_lint_baseline.json is stale-high on main: warnings 7683 vs actual 6979; pre-existing, not touched here).
A/B vite build: 199 vs 199 files, diff -rq: no differences.

files.behavior_change: Ten @typescript-eslint/* entries move 8.71.2 -> 8.72.0 in lockstep (forced by eslint-plugin's exact internal pins and parser peer range). Lint output and build output identical. Peer-flag churn reverted.

findings.status: process finding, not a code defect in this PR
findings.summary: Dependabot opened the parser bump separately as PR #459. This PR already moves parser to 8.72.0 in the lockfile. #459 on its own leaves eslint-plugin at 8.71.2 and installs a SECOND copy of six @typescript-eslint internals plus eslint-visitor-keys nested under parser/node_modules (400 -> 407 entries) -- the mixed-version state typescript-eslint does not support -- and its lockfile conflicts with this one. Merge this PR first; #459 should then be recreated by Dependabot (range-only) or closed, not fixed in place.
client_lint_baseline.json on main records 7683 warnings; actual is 6979. The ratchet passes but no longer locks in the reduction. Belongs in its own PR.

architecture_scan.acknowledgement_notes: Dev-only lint toolchain bump with identical lint and build output; findings are recorded, not remediated here.
